Name: Zombie Possesor Barn Animal (SNES) (Ghost Mod)
Author: StardewBlaster
Description:
[b]                                                                       [size=6]  ZOMBIE POSSESOR![/size][/b]
[b]                                               [size=5]   [/size][/b][size=5]Can be purchased from Marnie's Shop for 1500g[/size]

[size=4]Produces gold ore, then gold bar, then ghost crystal, then quartz as friendship gets higher.[/size]
[size=4]Only produces every 3 days, but produces a lot of valuable meat when you end its "life".[/size]

[size=4]Doesn't eat grass or hay, but can be fed treats every 2 days to increase friendship faster and maintain happiness, which is harder on account of its high happiness drain per day.[/size]

[b][size=5]Eats:[/size][/b]
[size=4]-Cave Carrot[/size]
[size=4]-Frozen Tear[/size]
[size=4]-Frozen Geode[/size]
[size=4]-Radioactive Ore[/size]

[size=4]This is an animal who's main purpose is death, literally. Max friendship Ghosts produce anywhere between 15k and 30k worth of meat when exorcised.[/size]
[size=4]The idea is a heavy focus on treats, seeing as its meat is its main purpose, and produce which decreases in quality later in its life to encourage you to lay it to rest.[/size]
[size=4]Radioactive ore is relatively useless in Stardew but makes for a fantastic treat for ghosts, as a way to both give more use to radioactive ore and buff ghosts' profit turnaround as you get into the late game.[/size]


[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=4]-SMAPI[/size]
[size=4]-Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]-Animal Husbandry Mod[/size]
[size=4]Animal Husbandry is not strictly required for the mod to run but it is entirely balanced around it. Delete the AHM folder if you please.[/size]

[b][size=5]Shout outs[/size][/b]
[size=4]MizuJakkaru for having great animal mods to reference for code functionality, and Luzze42 for having simpler animal mods to reference for code functionality, lol. Also Digus for answering a question I had making this mod, and for making the animal husbandry mod. Wonderful mod creators.[/size]

[b][size=6]Please report any bugs! All feedback is appreciated! Thank you![/size][/b]
